1.note: Literally "a limb of his generations (offspring)". Read here as "of what was born from him": woman came out of man's body. Uncertain.

2.note: מֻרְאָה is the crop of a bird with its filth, which the priest throws away (Lev 1:16). The word also sounds like מוֹרָא, "fear": "you have shown your terrors".

3.note: From Prov 23:32 "and like an adder it stings (יַפְרִשׁ)", said of wine. The verb is rare; "stings" follows the usual reading, "spreads its poison" is also given.

4.note: Prov 21:19 and 21:9 (= 25:24). בֵּית חֶבֶר is "a shared house", but חֶבֶר is also the name of the speaker, Ḥever the Kenite, not yet known to the narrator: "the house of Ḥever".

5.note: Exod 38:8: the laver was made from the mirrors (מַרְאֹת) of the women who served at the door of the Tent of Meeting. Here מַרְאוֹת is read also as "visions" of prophecy; both senses are carried in the line.

6.note: An echo of Gen 3:16 "your longing shall be for your husband", turned around: in bad times the men depend on a woman. The exact sense is uncertain.

7.note: חֲרוּפָה recalls the "slave woman designated (נֶחֱרֶפֶת) for a man" of Lev 19:20; the root also means "reviled".
